column1: # 雅思核心词汇 List 01（i 10001–10090）。每行：编号§单词§例句§译文（译文里恰好一处 **…** 标出对应词义）
10001 § academic § Academic writing requires clear structure and evidence. § **学术**写作需要清晰的结构和充分的论据。
10002 § achieve § Students who set clear goals are more likely to achieve high scores. § 设定明确目标的学生更有可能**取得**高分。
10003 § acquire § Children acquire language skills naturally at an early age. § 孩子在很小的时候就能自然地**习得**语言技能。
10004 § adapt § Teachers must adapt their lessons to suit different learning styles. § 教师必须**调整**教学内容，以适应不同的学习风格。
10005 § allocate § The university will allocate more funding to scientific research. § 大学将**拨出**更多经费用于科学研究。
10006 § approach § A student-centred approach often improves motivation. § 以学生为中心的**方法**往往能提高学习积极性。
10007 § assess § Tutors assess students' progress through regular tests. § 导师通过定期测验来**评估**学生的进步情况。
10008 § attain § Many learners attain fluency after years of practice. § 许多学习者经过多年练习后**达到**了流利的水平。
10009 § benefit § Education brings long-term benefits to both individuals and society. § 教育给个人和社会都带来长远的**益处**。
10010 § cognitive § Reading regularly enhances cognitive development in children. § 经常阅读能促进儿童的**认知**发展。
10011 § collaborate § Students collaborate in groups to complete research projects. § 学生们分组**合作**完成研究项目。
10012 § competency § Digital competency is now essential for most jobs. § 数字**能力**如今对大多数工作都至关重要。
10013 § compulsory § In many countries, school attendance is compulsory until age 16. § 在许多国家，16 岁以前上学是**强制性**的。
10014 § curriculum § The curriculum was revised to include more practical skills. § **课程体系**经过修订，增加了更多实用技能。
10015 § demonstrate § The experiment demonstrated the effectiveness of the new method. § 这项实验**证明**了新方法的有效性。
10016 § dropout § High dropout rates remain a serious problem in rural schools. § 农村学校的高**辍学**率仍然是一个严重问题。
10017 § evaluate § The programme will be evaluated at the end of the semester. § 该项目将在学期末接受**评估**。
10018 § feedback § Timely feedback helps students correct their mistakes. § 及时的**反馈**能帮助学生纠正错误。
10019 § graduate § University graduates generally enjoy better job prospects. § 大学**毕业生**通常拥有更好的就业前景。
10020 § implement § The school implemented a new policy on homework. § 学校**实施**了一项关于家庭作业的新政策。
10021 § incentive § Scholarships act as an incentive for students to study hard. § 奖学金对学生努力学习起到**激励**作用。
10022 § instruction § Clear instructions reduce confusion in the classroom. § 清晰的**指令**能减少课堂上的混乱。
10023 § interdisciplinary § Interdisciplinary courses combine knowledge from different fields. § **跨学科**课程融合了不同领域的知识。
10024 § literacy § Improving literacy is a priority in developing countries. § 提高**读写能力**是发展中国家的当务之急。
10025 § mentor § A mentor can offer valuable guidance to young researchers. § **导师**能为年轻的研究人员提供宝贵的指导。
10026 § motivate § Interesting activities motivate students to participate actively. § 有趣的活动能**激励**学生积极参与。
10027 § objective § The main objective of the course is to improve writing skills. § 这门课程的主要**目标**是提高写作能力。
10028 § outcome § The expected outcome of the project is higher exam scores. § 该项目预期的**成果**是提高考试成绩。
10029 § participate § All students are encouraged to participate in class discussions. § 鼓励所有学生**参与**课堂讨论。
10030 § pedagogy § Modern pedagogy emphasises student engagement. § 现代**教学法**强调学生的参与度。
10031 § policy § The government announced a new education policy. § 政府宣布了一项新的教育**政策**。
10032 § priority § Improving teacher training should be a top priority. § 改善教师培训应当是头等**优先事项**。
10033 § resource § Online resources support independent learning. § 在线**资源**有助于自主学习。
10034 § revise § She revised her essay before submitting it. § 她在提交之前**修改**了自己的文章。
10035 § scholarship § She won a scholarship to study abroad. § 她获得了出国留学的**奖学金**。
10036 § self-directed § Self-directed learning requires strong time-management skills. § **自主**学习需要很强的时间管理能力。
10037 § strategy § Using mind maps is an effective revision strategy. § 使用思维导图是一种有效的复习**策略**。
10038 § tuition § University tuition has risen sharply in recent years. § 近年来大学**学费**大幅上涨。
10039 § tutor § A tutor provided extra help with her writing. § 一位**辅导教师**在她的写作方面提供了额外帮助。
10040 § vocational § Vocational training prepares students for specific careers. § **职业**培训让学生为特定的职业做好准备。
10041 § workshop § The writing workshop covered coherence and cohesion. § 这场写作**研讨班**讲解了连贯性和衔接性。
10042 § enrolment § University enrolment has increased dramatically over the past decade. § 过去十年间，大学的**入学人数**急剧增加。
10043 § seminar § Students are required to attend weekly seminars. § 学生必须参加每周一次的**研讨课**。
10044 § syllabus § The syllabus lists all the topics covered this term. § **教学大纲**列出了本学期涵盖的所有主题。
10045 § assessment § Continuous assessment is fairer than a single final exam. § 平时**考核**比一次性的期末考试更公平。
10046 § attainment § Educational attainment strongly affects future income. § **受教育程度**对未来收入有很大影响。
10047 § critical thinking § Critical thinking helps students question assumptions. § **批判性思维**能帮助学生质疑既有的假设。
10048 § lifelong learning § Lifelong learning is vital in a rapidly changing world. § 在瞬息万变的世界里，**终身学习**至关重要。
10049 § numeracy § Basic numeracy is essential in everyday life. § 基本的**计算能力**在日常生活中必不可少。
10050 § problem-solving § Problem-solving is one of the most valued skills by employers. § **解决问题的能力**是雇主最看重的技能之一。
10051 § retention § Regular review improves the retention of new vocabulary. § 定期复习能提高新词汇的**记忆留存率**。
10052 § access § Students in remote areas often lack access to the internet. § 偏远地区的学生往往缺少互联网的**使用机会**。
10053 § algorithm § Social media platforms use algorithms to recommend content. § 社交媒体平台利用**算法**来推荐内容。
10054 § application § Mobile applications have changed the way we communicate. § 手机**应用程序**改变了我们的沟通方式。
10055 § artificial intelligence § Artificial intelligence is transforming many industries. § **人工智能**正在改变许多行业。
10056 § automate § Factories now automate most of their production lines. § 如今工厂已将大部分生产线**自动化**。
10057 § bandwidth § Streaming high-definition video requires a lot of bandwidth. § 高清视频的流式播放需要大量**带宽**。
10058 § component § The battery is a critical component of an electric car. § 电池是电动汽车的关键**部件**。
10059 § connectivity § Better connectivity enables remote working. § 更好的网络**互联互通**让远程办公成为可能。
10060 § cybersecurity § Cybersecurity has become a major concern for governments. § **网络安全**已成为各国政府高度关注的问题。
10061 § data § Companies collect vast amounts of data about consumers. § 公司收集了大量有关消费者的**数据**。
10062 § database § The results are stored in a central database. § 结果存储在一个中央**数据库**里。
10063 § device § People spend hours using mobile devices every day. § 人们每天花数小时使用移动**设备**。
10064 § digital § The digital revolution has changed the media industry. § **数字**革命改变了传媒行业。
10065 § download § You can download the app for free. § 你可以免费**下载**这款应用。
10066 § enable § The internet enables people to work from home. § 互联网**使得**人们能够在家工作。
10067 § enhance § New software will enhance the quality of online lessons. § 新软件将**提升**在线课程的质量。
10068 § evolve § Technology evolves faster than most people can adapt. § 技术**演变**的速度快过大多数人的适应速度。
10069 § gadget § People are often addicted to their electronic gadgets. § 人们常常沉迷于各种电子**小玩意儿**。
10070 § hardware § Upgrading the hardware can make the computer faster. § 升级**硬件**能让电脑运行得更快。
10071 § infrastructure § The country is investing heavily in digital infrastructure. § 该国正大力投资数字**基础设施**。
10072 § innovation § Innovation drives economic growth in modern societies. § 在现代社会，**创新**推动着经济增长。
10073 § interface § The app has a simple, user-friendly interface. § 这款应用有一个简洁、用户友好的**界面**。
10074 § internet § The internet has connected people across the globe. § **互联网**把全球各地的人们联系在了一起。
10075 § legacy § Many banks still rely on legacy computer systems. § 许多银行仍在使用**遗留**计算机系统。
10076 § machine learning § Machine learning powers many modern recommendation systems. § **机器学习**为许多现代推荐系统提供动力。
10077 § network § A reliable network is essential for online learning. § 稳定的**网络**对在线学习至关重要。
10078 § obsolete § Fax machines have become largely obsolete. § 传真机已基本**过时**了。
10079 § online § Online courses allow students to study at their own pace. § **在线**课程让学生可以按自己的节奏学习。
10080 § platform § Streaming platforms have replaced traditional TV for many people. § 对许多人来说，流媒体**平台**已经取代了传统电视。
10081 § privacy § Users worry about their privacy on social media. § 用户担心自己在社交媒体上的**隐私**。
10082 § processing § The new chip is powerful enough for image processing. § 这款新芯片性能强劲，足以胜任图像**处理**。
10083 § programme § The app runs a programme that tracks your exercise. § 这款应用运行着一个记录你运动情况的**程序**。
10084 § prototype § Engineers tested a prototype of the new device. § 工程师们测试了这款新设备的**原型**。
10085 § remote § Remote working has become the norm for many companies. § **远程**办公已成为许多公司的常态。
10086 § revolutionary § The smartphone was a revolutionary invention. § 智能手机是一项**革命性**的发明。
10087 § screen § Children should limit their screen time. § 孩子们应该限制**屏幕**使用时间。
10088 § security § Online security is threatened by hackers. § 网络**安全**受到黑客的威胁。
10089 § simulation § Flight simulators train pilots without real risks. § 飞行**模拟**器能让飞行员在没有真实风险的情况下接受训练。
10090 § software § The company develops software for language learning. § 这家公司开发语言学习**软件**。
